description: Synthetic bilingual scientific terminology regression, not real papers or an accuracy estimate. Fixed development/holdout cases; do not tune using holdout.

documents.title: Localized surface plasmon resonance
documents.content: Localized surface plasmon resonance arises from collective conduction electron oscillations in metal nanostructures. The resonance wavelength changes with the surrounding dielectric environment.

documents.title: Metasurface phase design
documents.content: A metasurface uses subwavelength scatterers to control the phase of transmitted light. The synthetic design uses a phase gradient to steer a beam.

documents.title: Detection threshold
documents.content: The limit of detection is determined from blank variability and a calibration slope. In this artificial example the threshold is 7 picomolar.

documents.title: Surface adsorption
documents.content: Nonspecific adsorption can generate background signals even when the target analyte is absent. A blocking step reduces unwanted attachment to the surface.

documents.title: Resonance linewidth
documents.content: The quality factor is the resonance frequency divided by its linewidth. A narrow resonance has a higher quality factor when its center frequency is held fixed.

documents.title: Binding recognition
documents.content: An antibody binds an antigen through its variable region. In the artificial binding protocol, the incubation time is 18 minutes.

documents.title: 缓冲液配制
documents.content: 磷酸盐缓冲盐水用于稳定溶液酸碱度。这份合成流程规定缓冲液的 pH 为 7.2，不代表实际实验建议。

documents.title: Planar surface waves
documents.content: Surface plasmon resonance in this example is excited on a planar metal film using a prism. The propagating mode differs from a localized particle resonance.

documents.title: Index calibration
documents.content: Refractive index sensitivity is reported as the wavelength shift per refractive index unit. The artificial sensor has a sensitivity of 142 nm/RIU.

documents.title: Particle fabrication
documents.content: Gold nanoparticles are stabilized using citrate in this artificial preparation. The mean particle diameter in the fixture is 36 nm.

documents.title: Sensor performance
documents.content: The figure of merit for this wavelength sensor is its refractive index sensitivity divided by the resonance linewidth. This definition is different from a resonance quality factor.

documents.title: Enzyme assay
documents.content: The enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay produces a colorimetric readout after substrate addition. The artificial plate is washed four times before the detection step.

documents.title: Surface chemistry
documents.content: Surface functionalization attaches receptor molecules to the substrate. A thiol group can anchor the synthetic receptor to a gold surface.

documents.title: 偏振控制
documents.content: 偏振描述光电场的振动方向。本合成案例用半波片旋转线偏振方向，与实际设备参数无关。

documents.title: 微流控输运
documents.content: 微流控通道将样品输送到检测区。合成示例的流量为每分钟 4 微升，不是实际实验建议。

documents.title: 核酸识别
documents.content: 脱氧核糖核酸的互补碱基配对用于探针识别。本合成方案使用固定于表面的单链探针。
